tailoring.headline: Fullstack E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & Headless APIs
tailoring.summary: E-Commerce developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building backend and storefront solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proficient in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs for headless commerce and PWA integration. Hands-on with JavaScript, storefront customization, Solr search, and complex integrations across PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Experienced in agile environments, CI/CD deployment cycles, and production troubleshooting.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Fullstack - eCommerce (DRWN)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Fullstack - eCommerce role through Darwin Recruitment. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in combining robust Java/Spring architectures with headless storefront integrations.

bullets.label: Fullstack E-Commerce Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering catalog management, pricing, and storefront customization.

bullets.label: Headless & PWA APIs
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC Web Services for Headless Commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends, ensuring reliable data delivery across consumer touchpoints.

bullets.label: End-to-End Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms.

bullets.label: Platform Optimization & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and supported high-volume transactions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my background.

tailoring.why_company: Darwin Recruitment's strong market presence in placing technical specialists into impactful digital commerce projects makes this position an ideal fit. Having spent over five years engineering high-load e-commerce platforms and headless architectures for international leaders like Shell and Rockwell Automation, I am keen to bring my integration depth and fullstack commerce background to your client's development team.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of enterprise experience across SAP Commerce Cloud, Java/Spring, and headless PWA APIs, I am eager to apply my fullstack e-commerce and integration expertise to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed the Fullstack - eCommerce role at Darwin Recruitment. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms and headless APIs at Shell and Rockwell Automation, I would welcome the chance to connect and discuss how my background aligns with your client's needs.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and application for the Fullstack - eCommerce position. With over 5 years of experience engineering scalable commerce platforms, headless APIs, and Java/Spring services for Shell and Rockwell Automation, I provide hands-on expertise across backend and storefront integration. I hold a valid German work permit, reside in Karlsruhe, and am available from 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
